company.name: Harvey
company.shortDescription: Harvey provides an artificial intelligence solutions designed for law firms and corporate legal departments.
company.description: Harvey assists legal professionals with research, document drafting, contract analysis, and bulk file review within a unified digital environment. Its system features specialized AI agents that execute legal workflows, extract key information from unstructured documents, and generate cited draft work product. The platform also integrates with existing legal tools, document management software, and enterprise communication systems to streamline collaboration between internal teams and external counsel.
